description: List the eBay shipping (fulfillment) business policies the seller has on each eBay site the connection sells on: fulfillmentPolicyId, name, freeShipping, shippingCost of the first domestic service (null for CALCULATED shipping), costType, handlingTime, domestic and international services, ship-to regions, and isDefault — the connection default. productCount is how many products chose the policy themselves; staleAssignments are product choices pointing at a policy eBay no longer has. Reads the stored copy; a site never read before is read from eBay, and refresh true reads eBay now. Reads only. Use a fulfillmentPolicyId from here with set_product_ebay_fulfillment_policy, bulk_set_ebay_fulfillment_policy or set_ebay_default_fulfillment_policy; for one product's policy use get_product_ebay_fulfillment_policy.

marketplaceId.description: An eBay MARKETPLACE id such as EBAY_IT. Omit it to list every marketplace the eBay connection sells on.

refresh.description: true reads the policies from eBay now instead of the stored copy. A marketplace never read before is read from eBay either way.

name: list_ebay_fulfillment_policies
title: List eBay shipping policies
